entities.name: TMEM266
observations: The 531-residue query is essentially identical to reviewed human TMEM266 (UniProt Q2M3C6; 100% identity over 98.5% query coverage).
Reviewed annotations describe TMEM266 as a multi-pass plasma-membrane voltage-sensor protein that does not form a functional ion channel; precise physiological role remains unclear.
Contains an Ion_trans/PF00520 domain at residues 102–217, consistent with a voltage-sensor-like transmembrane module.
Reported to undergo rapid and slow voltage-dependent structural rearrangements; a zinc-binding site modulates the slow conformational transition.
Reported localization includes dendrites and soma/perikaryon of cerebellar granule neurons, especially postsynaptic regions of glutamatergic mossy fibers.
Reported subunit is a disulfide-linked homodimer.

entities.name: TMEM266 orthologs
observations: Reviewed macaque and mouse proteins show 96.0% and 87.4% identity, respectively, with full-length coverage and the same voltage-sensor, membrane localization, and non-channel annotations.

entities.name: Ion_trans PF00520
observations: Detected in the query at residues 102–217 with i-Evalue 4.8e-08; this region corresponds to the membrane-embedded voltage-sensor-like module.
